checkpoints.description: [1/2] Review the last 75 pushes: cover every exit-2 gate script in the CI CLI contract

impact_assessment.why: 97b50ff made the CLI contract loop set -e safe, but the loop still tests only six scripts; check_project_hygiene, proof_gate and check_test_budgets implement the same --help/exit-2 contract and are omitted, so the step's 'all entrypoints' claim is false.
impact_assessment.benefits: The CI contract gate exercises every standalone gate script that declares the exit-2 misuse behavior, so a regression in any of them fails CI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CI CLI contract; dependency: bash on the runner; concurrency: none; state: ci.yml, tests, ADR, map
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first loop-coverage test, local misuse probes for the three scripts, full unit tier, root scan and gates
